name: Sale Return Receipt
html:
{% set totals = frappe.db.sql("SELECT CAST(return_ht AS CHAR) AS return_ht, CAST(return_tva AS CHAR) AS return_tva, CAST(return_ttc AS CHAR) AS return_ttc, CAST(debt_reduction AS CHAR) AS debt_reduction, CAST(refund_amount AS CHAR) AS refund_amount FROM `tabSale Return` WHERE name=%s AND business=%s", (doc.name, doc.business), as_dict=True)[0] %}{% set line_amounts = frappe.db.sql("SELECT name, CAST(return_ht AS CHAR) AS return_ht, CAST(return_tva AS CHAR) AS return_tva, CAST(return_ttc AS CHAR) AS return_ttc FROM `tabSale Return Item` WHERE parent=%s AND parenttype='Sale Return'", doc.name, as_dict=True) %}

{{ _("Return Receipt") }}

{{ _("Business:") }} {{ frappe.db.get_value('Business', doc.business, 'business_name') }}

{{ _("Original Invoice:") }} {{ frappe.db.get_value('Sale', doc.original_sale, 'invoice_number') or doc.original_sale }}

{{ _("Customer:") }} {{ frappe.db.get_value('Customer', doc.customer, 'customer_name') if doc.customer else _('Walk-in Customer') }}

{{ _("Return Date:") }} {{ doc.get_formatted('return_date') }}

{% for row in doc.items %}{% set line = line_amounts | selectattr('name', 'equalto', row.name) | first %}{% endfor %}
{{ _("Product") }}{{ _("Quantity") }}{{ _("UOM") }}HTTVATTC
{{ row.product_name }}{{ row.quantity }}{{ _(row.uom) }}{{ line.return_ht or '0.000' }}{{ line.return_tva or '0.000' }}{{ line.return_ttc or '0.000' }}
{{ _("Return HT") }}{{ totals.return_ht or '0.000' }} TND
{{ _("Return TVA") }}{{ totals.return_tva or '0.000' }} TND
{{ _("Return TTC") }}{{ totals.return_ttc or '0.000' }} TND
{{ _("Debt Reduction") }}{{ totals.debt_reduction or '0.000' }} TND
{{ _("Refund Amount") }}{{ totals.refund_amount or '0.000' }} TND
{{ _("Refund Status") }}{{ _(doc.refund_status) }}

{{ _("Reason:") }} {{ doc.reason }}

{% if doc.notes %}

{{ _("Notes:") }} {{ doc.notes }}

{% endif %}
